<a id="body"></a>

## Body

Copilot /restart retains seat/native_session/spawn_id, so session binding alone cannot reject an old process's report. Carry the registered Copilot host tuple (pid, proc_start), not the extension child's identity; reject a mismatch before recovery mutation.

Typing acknowledgement is not restart completion. Pending is valid only while its restart control remains queued. Once Done or Failed, a report from the same process must produce one not-restarted notice, not silently wait and retry. Recovery advice must use /exit followed by native pij-rs revive with the seat shell-quoted; the shim revive path is unsupported.

Keep report/decide/persist/enqueue serialized per seat, and do not let wall-clock jumps expire a live monotonic cooldown. These complement the existing host-identity and shell-quoting notes rather than changing the C33 trust boundary.

Evidence: crates/daemon/src/auth_recovery.rs; auth_recovery_tests.rs regressions a_restart_that_settles_without_a_new_process_is_reported_once (Done and Failed), two_reports_at_once_queue_one_restart, and a_wall_clock_jump_never_ends_the_window; stale-process route regression in crates/daemon/tests/copilot_compact.rs. Review receipt: #254 security verdict fb4249a5.
